Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: wide workflow-stage image for a project of the Olympuz family
Primary request: the stage where the answers are counted and split by group: many gold bands gather into a few and land on one carved tablet.
Input images: Image 1 is the immutable Pantheon style reference; Image 2 is the required family-signature column.
Subject: on a plain ivory floor, nine thin sky-blue threads run flat from the left edge and gather at a low marble junction block. Out of the block three muted-gold bands rise, curve once through the air together and land flat on a large upright marble tablet at the right, becoming three straight carved grooves of clearly different lengths, one under another. A classical white-marble column stands at the far right, clearly separated from the tablet.
Composition/framing: 16:9 landscape, the flow reading left to right, generous empty ivory space above, nothing cropped.
Style/medium: premium restrained 3D marble render, monumental carving with real weight, physically plausible materials, warm ivory Apple-like presentation
Lighting/mood: soft daylight from upper left, long gentle shadows, calm and welcoming. Gold glows softly FROM WITHIN, never lit by a lamp or a hard rim light.
Color palette: ivory #F3EFE8, bright ivory #FBFAF6, white marble, muted gold #C9A87A for bands and rims only, sky blue #B8D6EA for the ground threads only, charcoal #3E3A36
Constraints:
- Everything rests on the ground and casts its own shadow. Nothing hovers.
- The small figures are plain and identical, without faces and without attributes.
